values.alara_standard_id: [V1 4029] All crew radiation exposures shall be minimized using the ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) principle.

derived.name: game_exposure_limit_mapping
derived.unit: teaching units Z vs mSv / mGy-Eq
derived.formula: Game Z <= 3 (CH1) and Z <= 6 (CH7) represent staying below NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4031] 250 mSv short-term SPE limit; Z is a teaching unit, never mSv.
derived.drives: P-02, P-13, P-14 exposure limit Flight Rule and ALARA mastery star

derived.name: alara_in_gameplay
derived.value: Preparing W4-W6 or K2 shelter before the storm peak reduces Z from 3 (limit) to 2 (P-02 Bloom/Golden) or 0 (P-13/P-14), practicing [V1 4029] ALARA within power and garden water constraints.
derived.formula: S = min(6, W + K); dose per storm shift = 3 (S=0..1), 2 (S=2..3), 1 (S=4..5), 0 (S=6, below storm operational threshold)

boundary: NASA-STD-3001 limits are in mSv and mGy-Eq; game exposure Z is a dimensionless teaching score (SIMULATED) and S=6 ('0 zaps') means 'below the storm operational threshold', not zero physical radiation.

quotes_found: All crew radiation exposures shall be minimized using the ALARA principle
less than a NASA effective dose of 250 mSv
limited to an effective dose of 250 mSv per event
